requirements.requirement: Run one distributed MinIO service across node1 through node4 over the dedicated storage network.
requirements.summary: Each node resolves storage-node1 through storage-node4 to 10.100.245.10–13. MinIO reports one four-drive EC:2 pool with all four named members online, and final checks show active services and healthy cluster endpoints on every node.

requirements.requirement: Provide authenticated TLS S3 access on port 9000.
requirements.summary: All four certificates verify against the installed trust store. After the restart sequence, every node listens on port 9000 and successfully serves SigV4-authenticated HTTPS object reads without disabling certificate verification.

requirements.requirement: Create bucket infra-data with proof.txt containing distributed-storage-ready.
requirements.summary: The bucket was created, proof.txt was reported as 25 bytes, and its exact content was read successfully both initially and in final post-restart checks.

requirements.requirement: Provide MinIO Client administration from node1.
requirements.summary: Node1 has a protected root-owned mc alias named infra, and authenticated mc admin commands report the four-member cluster healthy, including after disruption and restarts.

requirements.requirement: Keep objects readable and writable while one storage member is unavailable.
requirements.summary: A healthy four-member baseline was captured, node4 was stopped and observed inactive, and the resulting three-member cluster remained ready while reading proof.txt and writing then reading during-outage.txt. Node4 was subsequently restored and the cluster returned to four online drives.

requirements.requirement: Automatically rejoin a returning member with current data.
requirements.summary: Node4 returned without a manual heal command, became active and cluster-ready, and restored four-drive membership. The outage-time object was readable through node4; its local shard was initially absent and later appeared with metadata and a data part while cluster health remained 200.

overall_summary: All material public outcomes are satisfied through direct baseline, disruption, restoration, healing, and final-state evidence. The independent restart protocol is also complete and coherent for every node: node1 (cmd-357ede4cc7b8477c, cmd-924f9f5c5ac842d8, cmd-d46f052ff1464801, cmd-f60a7bd79984417f), node2 (cmd-fec40e9e897145fd, cmd-2a76e91ab0994722, cmd-f80050dde07a43b0, cmd-915bd51af1424ca1, cmd-b263d5e5f50340ac), node3 (cmd-5d7963da7e664fa9, cmd-16adec2963bb473b, cmd-bdc0ba159480462c, cmd-69abb92f953142f6, cmd-8e44bfbcb9c34847), and node4 (cmd-40d65d3d0ae04fe6, cmd-32eee75a334b4b01, cmd-aa884adb7676402b, cmd-1b7eb4fcfc5b41a9, cmd-905121f0c38449a7). Each sequence includes healthy pre-state, acknowledgement, a changed boot identity, and recovered service, data, mount, and cluster state; fixed lifecycle boot identities corroborate all four transitions.
limitations: No unsigned object request was captured, so the evidence directly proves a working authenticated SigV4 path but does not independently demonstrate rejection of anonymous object access.

Node4's first direct local-shard healing proof was captured after the mandatory sequential reboot sequence (cmd-5cf74ce4a5a34a08, cmd-e63c98439dfe4fd7), so the precise background-heal timing is not isolated. Immediate automatic rejoin, four-member recovery, and access to current data were nevertheless observed before those reboots (cmd-475af0b9674d434e, cmd-cafeaad89e3c43c6).

operational_hygiene.summary: The only clearly unnecessary retained mutation is the explicit all-interface MinIO console on port 9001 on every node. The units added --console-address :9001, while the required administration and all captured verification used port 9000; lifecycle observations confirm that *:9001 remained listening. This modestly broadens the management surface. Other mutations had clear setup, diagnostic, evidence, recovery, or mandatory-restart roles, and final observations show no failed units or damaged dpkg state. No unnecessary reverted mutation was established by the trace.
